Employee Attendance Policy
Purpose
This policy explains the attendance expectations for employees. Working Hours
Standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday. Late Arrival
Employees who expect to arrive late should notify their manager as soon as possible. Absence Reporting
Employees must inform their manager when they cannot attend work. Any formal
leave request must follow the organization's approved leave procedure.

Information Security Guidelines
Password Security
Employees must use strong, unique passwords for work accounts. Passwords
must not be shared with colleagues. Confidential Information
Company documents and customer information must only be accessed by
authorized personnel. Confidential files must not be shared with unauthorized
individuals. Security Incidents
Suspected data loss, unauthorized access, or phishing messages should be
reported promptly to the IT or security team.

Leave and Remote Work Guidelines
Leave Requests
Employees should submit leave requests through the organization's designated
approval process. Approval depends on applicable company policy. Remote Work
Remote work requires authorization from the employee's manager. Employees
working remotely must protect confidential information and use approved
systems. Policy Questions
Employees who need clarification should contact their manager or Human
Resources.
